subject: 2026 Kids' Choice Awards
query: when are the kids choice awards 2026
title: When are the Kids' Choice Awards 2026? Nov. 14 on CBS and Nickelodeon
answer: The 2026 Kids' Choice Awards air live on Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, from 8 to 9:30 p.m. ET (5 to 6:30 p.m. PT) on CBS and Nickelodeon. Singer Alex Warren hosts the show from Television City in Los Angeles. Paramount+ Premium subscribers can stream it live.
body:
This is the first time the Kids' Choice Awards will air on CBS, according to Paramount's press site. Paramount+ Premium subscribers can watch live through their local CBS feed, and both Premium and Essential subscribers can stream the show on demand the next day. Outside the U.S., the show comes to Paramount+ after its Nickelodeon premiere.

Taylor Swift leads this year's individual nominees with six nominations, and Ariana Grande and Sabrina Carpenter are among the nominees with five each. Fans vote in 36 categories, and new categories this year include Watch Party: Kids' Choice, Favorite On-Screen Duo/Trio and Favorite Clutch Player of the Year. Winners of the Kids' Choice Awards traditionally get an orange blimp trophy, and many get slimed on stage.
in_the_news: Nickelodeon's Kids' Choice Awards air on Nov. 14, 2026, hosted by Alex Warren, with Taylor Swift leading the nominations.
